rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the general means of supporting oneself and staying alive.

example.english: We rely on this plot of land for our subsistence.
example.traditional: 我哋靠呢塊田維持生計。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kaau3 ne1 faai3 tin4 wai4 ci4 sang1 gai3

rows.note: Use this for concrete necessities such as food, water, and other basic goods rather than income itself.

example.english: Food and water are essential for subsistence.
example.traditional: 食物同食水都係生活必需品。
example.jyutping: sik6 mat6 tung4 sik6 seoi2 dou1 hai6 sang1 wut6 bit1 seoi1 ban2

rows.note: Use this when the subsistence means specifically refers to money needed for everyday living.

example.english: I set aside enough for subsistence every month.
example.traditional: 我每個月都要預留一筆生活費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 jyu6 lau4 jat1 bat1 sang1 wut6 fai3
